brief:
The Hind Rajab Foundation filed a war crimes complaint in India against an Israeli soldier accused of deliberately demolishing civilian property in Khan Younis, Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The soldier was reportedly visiting India when the complaint was lodged. The foundation alleged the destruction of civilian structures constituted violations of international humanitarian law during Israel's military operations in the territory.

The complaint names specific allegations related to the demolition of homes and civilian infrastructure in Khan Younis. The action represents an effort to pursue legal accountability through Indian courts for conduct alleged to have occurred during the conflict. Details of the soldier's identity and the precise scope of the allegations remain unclear from initial reports of the filing.
